name: agent-governance
description: Compiles a per-session governing document from the records corpus and injects it at UserPromptSubmit (issue #143).

enable_agent_governance.title: Enable agent governance compilation
enable_agent_governance.description: Compile and inject the governing document at UserPromptSubmit. Set false to turn this off; also settable per-invocation as AGENT_GOVERNANCE_ENABLE_AGENT_GOVERNANCE=false.
